_comment: Base config for moss/train_concept_lora.py: one artist LoRA on Kromoss at 1024 px, batch 1, one GPU. moss/tools/launch_artist_loras.py fills artist / parquet_path / cache_path / ckpt_path per artist. Speed switches picked by moss/tools/bench_concept_lora.py on one RTX PRO 6000 (batch 1, 1024 px): eager 0.747 s/step (50.9 GiB) -> compile 0.532 -> + fuse_qkv 0.519 -> + fp8 rowwise 0.409 -> max-autotune 0.39 (34.5 GiB, ~7.2 min per 1000-step LoRA incl. compile). Losses within run-to-run noise; previews match bf16. flash beats cudnn/efficient (1.18/1.10 s eager); static shapes, CUDA graphs and 2 trainers per GPU do not help.
